about: Held-out hand-labelled incident requests, written and committed before any judge read them, for reporting element readings tuned on judged_requests.json. Labelled by the same rule: a request states an element when a careful reader would say it says so. sensitive-data: the data in question includes, or may include, information private to or identifying people (names, contact details, addresses, account, payment, health or employment records) or secrets (passwords, keys, tokens, cookies, credentials); saying it holds none, or saying nothing of its content, is false. public-data: the information may be shared publicly or with anyone, or holds nothing sensitive (redacted, aggregate, status-only). unverified: some fact of the incident (its cause, impact or scope) is not yet known or confirmed. coordination-needed: several people or teams need to work together or share one place or view.
